Remark
[Projection identity for volume]

Source: petersen:page-0027 ↗ def:pet-ch1-volume-form-local

For an oriented orthonormal frame and any vector $X$, \[ \operatorname {vol}(E_1,\ldots ,E_{i-1},X,E_{i+1},\ldots ,E_n) =g(X,E_i). \]
